description: Defines the required relationships between Runtime, Audit, and Spend ledgers for forensic coherence.

primary.name: corr_id
primary.description: Global correlation ID for the user interaction/trace.

primary.name: intent_id
primary.description: Unique ID of the intent envelope (proposal).

primary.name: spend_txn_id
primary.description: Unique ID of the economic resource reservation.

primary.name: audit_event_id
primary.description: Unique ID of the authorization decision.

spend_to_audit.requirement: Every terminal spend event (COMMIT, ROLLBACK, EXPIRE) MUST include a valid 'audit_event_id' that exists in the audit trail.
spend_to_audit.exception: RESERVE events may have null or 'PENDING' audit_event_id.

audit_to_spend.requirement: Audit events related to resource-gated operations SHOULD include 'spend_txn_id' in the 'detail' object.

identity_consistency.description: The 'identity' and 'op_key' fields MUST match across all linked events (Spend, Audit, Decision) for a given transaction.

invariants.description: Every RESERVE must have exactly one terminal event (COMMIT, ROLLBACK, or EXPIRE).
The audit_event_id in a spend terminal event must match the authoritative ID of the decision.
